title: Rust Workspace Bootstrap
objective: Establish the target Rust workspace, coding standards, and build factory without changing user-visible behavior.

stories.title: Create Rust workspace skeleton
stories.outcome: Create crates for model, safety, inventory, policy, provider API, store, CLI, TUI, and later Guardian.
acceptance_criteria: Workspace builds on macOS, Linux, and Windows tier-1 toolchains.
Crate dependency direction follows target architecture and has no cycles.
No provider-specific code is placed in core model/safety crates.

stories.title: Establish Rust quality baseline
stories.outcome: Adopt fmt, clippy, tests, cargo-deny, RustSec audit, MSRV policy, and dependency rules.
acceptance_criteria: Warnings are denied in CI for project code.
Unknown registries/git sources are denied unless explicitly approved.
verification: Quality workflow fails on injected lint and denied dependency fixtures.

stories.title: Define error and diagnostic model
stories.outcome: Create typed error categories and stable machine-facing exit mapping.
acceptance_criteria: Errors separate invalid input, safety block, incomplete inventory, compatibility failure, mutation failure, and internal fault.
Human and JSON diagnostics share stable error codes.
verification: Golden diagnostic tests across all categories.

stories.title: Introduce deterministic clock and filesystem seams
stories.outcome: Make time and filesystem observation injectable for tests without abstracting away security-critical OS semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Tests can freeze time and synthesize filesystem facts.
Production paths still use explicit OS-backed implementations.
verification: Determinism test repeats plan generation byte-for-byte.
